title: Tic Tac videos seen in the Pentagon before release; better videos exist

tellings.quote: tac videos that are so well known lou elizondo was behind releasing those videos i remember seeing them in the pentagon before they were released but there are more videos some are better

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff, who has worked on government research into the unexplained, says he saw the Tic Tac videos, military cockpit footage of a white oval object shaped like the mint, inside the Pentagon before they were made public in 2017. He says Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, was behind their release, and adds that "there are more videos, some are better," which would mean the government holds clearer footage than the public has seen.
